artifact: Account settings page: submit button label

scope.rationale: Only the submit button label changed from "Submit" to "Save changes"; layout, styles, and other content are unchanged.

success_condition: The user recognizes the button as saving their changes and can operate it
evidence: Before and after diff of evals/fixtures/button-page.html
Source inspection of the button element and its styles
Browser renders at 320 CSS px and 200% text size after the change

changes.reason: "Save changes" states the outcome; "Submit" does not.

checks.evidence: The new label names the saving outcome and matches the form's purpose.
checks.impact: Users understand that the button saves their details.
checks.verification: Read the label in the context of the form heading and fields.

checks.evidence: The button has no aria-label, so its accessible name is the visible text "Save changes".
checks.impact: Voice-control and screen-reader users hear and can say the same label.
checks.verification: Inspect the button markup for overriding name attributes.

checks.evidence: Rendered at 320 CSS px and with 200% text size: the label stays on one line at 320 px and wraps to two lines without clipping at 200%.
checks.impact: The longer label remains readable and operable in narrow and enlarged layouts.
checks.verification: Repeat the 320 CSS px and 200% text renders after any further label change.

checks.evidence: The change does not affect records, layout grammar, or content volume.
checks.impact: Not evaluated by this targeted verification.
checks.remediation: Run release verification before a release decision.
checks.verification: Include in the next release verification.

limitations: Targeted to the changed label; this is not a release or WCAG conformance decision.
Assistive-technology output was not sampled; the accessible name was checked in markup.
